MF01.priority: Support assigned actual runtime blocker; while E1 is open, prioritize route/schedule representation and blocker discrimination.
requirements: Generate materially different representations/invariants/reductions, not restatements
Use independent checks where feasible
External observations only; no canonical runtime objects

MF02.priority: When explicitly fresh-authorized, measure executable route and same-total-budget schedule truth.
requirements: Freeze task/evaluator/source versions, executable route set, model/tools, seeds/repetitions, budget/accounting
Measure BASE, SBS, single-route VBS, AUTO, and best admissible same-budget ORACLE_SCHEDULE/portfolio when multi-route schedules are allowed
Record availability/UNKNOWN, raw outcomes, work and complete cost
Never treat method cards as executable routes or single-route VBS as a universal schedule ceiling

MF03.priority: Attack assigned blocker with distinct lemmas, invariants, decompositions, reductions, constructors, pruning or representation changes.
requirements: Score usefulness by downstream work reduction/new exact actions
Reusable object => EXTERNAL_VERIFIED_PRODUCT_CANDIDATE with type/version/dependencies/checker
Transferable method => crossing-event candidate requiring falsifier, unrelated transfer and prospective controls
No ProductStore/runtime object claims

MF04.priority: Assume the assigned candidate/closure is false and seek the cheapest discriminating failure.
requirements: Attack E1 schedule/stochasticity, G1 comparability, C1 type/version/dependency/checker/full cost, E3 executable/confounds, orchestration/runtime handoff
Search hidden assumptions, stale-state, cache/context/retention and cost confounds
Failed falsifier search is not proof

MF05.priority: Measure generic product reuse only when actual runtime support and an assignment make C1 eligible.
requirements: Compare closure disabled, enabled with product absent, enabled after independently generated+verified product
Freeze product identity/type/version/dependencies/checker/operator/task/evaluator/model/tools/budget
Charge generation, verification, storage/serialization, lookup, restoration, combination/operator, invalidation and final verify
If runtime support absent, emit implementation requirement only

MM01.priority: Use assigned disjoint React evidence only when explicitly fresh-enabled; otherwise replay-safe.
requirements: Derive smallest domain-general bounded mechanism/code requirement
Cover preservation/observer/contract/contamination/mutation controls
Origin task cannot promote

MM02.priority: Focus interface contracts, temporal/state checkpoints, standards/API semantics, complete call-site propagation, cancellation/incremental delivery and semantic-vs-evaluator separation.
requirements: Use assigned disjoint fresh task only when fresh-enabled
Freeze source versions and independently check material claims
Origin task cannot promote

MM03.priority: Focus relational contract-surface closure, boundary assumptions, producer/consumer obligations, authority provenance, substrate guarantees, preservation and false-positive suppression.
requirements: Use assigned disjoint fresh task only when fresh-enabled
Attack incomplete authoritative universes and boundary leaks
Origin task cannot promote

MM04.priority: Focus architecture-surface closure, source-selection partitions, dynamic registration, reachability/terminal semantics, preservation universes and nonvacuity.
requirements: Use assigned disjoint fresh task only when fresh-enabled
Attack omitted surfaces, N/A/exclusion and mutation/ablation
Origin task cannot promote

MM05.priority: Run prospective controls only on actual executable assigned candidates.
requirements: Compare L=LEARNED_PROPOSAL, R=RANDOM_ADMISSIBLE from same mutation/security envelope, N=NO_CHANGE_EQUAL_COMPUTE
Freeze runtime/artifact hashes, task/evaluator/model/tools, proposal+execution budget, cache/retention, seeds/scoring
Include feature/probe/selection overhead inside matched cost
Missing executable artifacts/evaluator => NOT_MEASURED

MM07.priority: Run only assigned already-consumed diagnostics unless fresh prospective self-improvement is explicitly authorized.
requirements: BEFORE/AFTER same source/task/evaluator/model/tools/budget/cache-retention
Report decomposable components and predeclared composite
Same-suite gain is diagnostic only
After scores freeze, propose at most one bounded NEXT_SELF_CANDIDATE; no self-promotion

EXT01.priority: Audit actual bound Foundry/Mastermind/runtime artifacts, GitHub-bus integrity, E1/G1/C1/E3, and runtime handoffs.
requirements: Reject task-only claims as runtime implementation
Independently cross-check critical artifact and transport claims
No deep research; emit research_needs only
